levels.name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"
levels.description: After triggering the Elemental Absorption from the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms."

levels.name: "Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"
levels.description: While the Swallow-Wisp Shield is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.

levels.name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"
levels.description: Increases the Level of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: "With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"
levels.description: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.

levels.name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"
levels.description: Increases the Level of Lustrous Moonrise by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"
levels.description: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance gains 1 additional charge.
